candidates.statement: Payment service calls from order time out (ReadTimeout on POST payment /v1/authorizations), causing order and checkout to return 502; gateway /v1/checkout shows 16 502s and p95 ~2425ms while inventory/redis calls succeed.

report.explanation: Checkout 502s align with transport ReadTimeouts on order->payment calls; inventory and redis succeed, so the failing hop is payment. Bounded to downstream latency at payment; payment-internal cause not yet observed.
